File.DescribedExactlyWhenCreated.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[
					s.status === "",
					s.filename === "",
					s.content_type === "",
					s.sha256 === "",
					s.size === 0,
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[s.status !== "", s.filename !== "", s.content_type !== "", s.sha256 !== ""].every(
					(ok) => ok,
				),
			].some((ok) => ok)

File.ContentNeverChanges.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status === "",
				[
					after.filename === before.filename,
					after.content_type === before.content_type,
					after.size === before.size,
					after.sha256 === before.sha256,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

File.ReservationsAreNumberedInOrder.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			[
				after.reservations === before.reservations,
				[command._tag === "ReserveFile", after.reservations === before.reservations + 1].every(
					(ok) => ok,
				),
			].some((ok) => ok)
